1//! Environment providers backed by the Datadog Agent.
2//!
3//! [`RemoteAgentEnvironmentProvider`] gives a remote agent its hostname, autodiscovery events, and workload metadata.
4//! In connected mode, each of those comes from the Datadog Agent over its own connection. In standalone mode, the
5//! hostname is fixed and the rest is unavailable.
6

31// SAFETY: The value is demonstrably not zero.
32const DEFAULT_STRING_INTERNER_SIZE_BYTES: NonZeroUsize = NonZeroUsize::new(512 * 1024).unwrap();
33const DEFAULT_CONTAINERD_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);
34const DEFAULT_CONTAINERD_QUERY_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
35
36pub(crate) fn root_provider_id() -> SubsystemIdentifier {
37    SubsystemIdentifier::from_segments(["env_provider"])
38}

40/// Settings for the workload provider.
41#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
42#[non_exhaustive]
43pub struct WorkloadSettings {
44    /// Size, in bytes, of the string interner shared by the workload metadata collectors.
45    ///
46    /// The interner holds the entity IDs and tags received from the Datadog Agent and container runtimes. Hosts with
47    /// many containers may need to increase it. Defaults to 512 KiB.
48    pub string_interner_size_bytes: NonZeroUsize,
49
50    /// Path to the containerd gRPC socket, if one is configured explicitly.
51    ///
52    /// Defaults to `None`, which probes the well-known socket paths.
53    pub containerd_socket_path: Option<PathBuf>,
54
55    /// Timeout for establishing a containerd gRPC connection. Defaults to 1 second.
56    pub containerd_connection_timeout: Duration,
57
58    /// Per-RPC timeout for containerd API calls. Defaults to 5 seconds.
59    pub containerd_query_timeout: Duration,
60
61    /// Root of the procfs filesystem to read container processes from, if one is configured explicitly.
62    ///
63    /// Defaults to `None`, which detects the root automatically.
64    pub proc_root: Option<PathBuf>,
65
66    /// Root of the cgroupfs filesystem to read container cgroups from, if one is configured explicitly.
67    ///
68    /// Defaults to `None`, which detects the root automatically.
69    pub cgroup_root: Option<PathBuf>,
70}
71
72impl WorkloadSettings {
73    /// Creates a new `WorkloadSettings` with the given string interner size, and every other setting at its default.
74    pub fn new(string_interner_size_bytes: NonZeroUsize) -> Self {
75        Self {
76            string_interner_size_bytes,
77            ..Self::default()
78        }
79    }
80}
81
82impl Default for WorkloadSettings {
83    fn default() -> Self {
84        Self {
85            string_interner_size_bytes: DEFAULT_STRING_INTERNER_SIZE_BYTES,
86            containerd_socket_path: None,
87            containerd_connection_timeout: DEFAULT_CONTAINERD_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT,
88            containerd_query_timeout: DEFAULT_CONTAINERD_QUERY_TIMEOUT,
89            proc_root: None,
90            cgroup_root: None,
91        }
92    }
93}

95/// Environment provider for a remote agent.
96///
97/// This environment provider is designed for a remote agent's normal deployment environment, which is running alongside
98/// the Datadog Agent. The underlying providers communicate directly with the Datadog Agent to receive information such
99/// as the hostname, entity tags, workload metadata events, and more.
100///
101/// # Opting out for testing/benchmarking
102///
103/// In order to facilitate testing/benchmarking where running the Datadog Agent isn't desirable, a standalone provider
104/// can be created with [`standalone`](Self::standalone) instead.
105///
106/// This effectively disables origin enrichment (no entity tags) and causes metrics to be tagged with a fixed hostname.
107#[derive(Clone)]
108pub struct RemoteAgentEnvironmentProvider {
109    host_provider: BoxedHostProvider,
110    workload_provider: Option<RemoteAgentWorkloadProvider>,
111    autodiscovery_provider: Option<BoxedAutodiscoveryProvider>,
112    health_registry: HealthRegistry,
113}
114
115impl RemoteAgentEnvironmentProvider {
116    /// Creates a standalone `RemoteAgentEnvironmentProvider` that reports the given hostname.
117    ///
118    /// All other functionality operates in a no-op fashion, so no supervisor is needed.
119    ///
120    /// # Errors
121    ///
122    /// If `hostname` is `None` or empty, an error is returned.
123    pub fn standalone(hostname: Option<String>, health_registry: &HealthRegistry) -> Result<Self, GenericError> {
124        warn!("Running in standalone mode. Origin detection/enrichment and other features dependent upon the Datadog Agent will not be available.");
125
126        let hostname = match hostname {
127            Some(hostname) if !hostname.is_empty() => hostname,
128            _ => {
129                return Err(generic_error!(
130                    "A non-empty hostname must be configured (`hostname`) when running in standalone mode."
131                ))
132            }
133        };
134
135        Ok(Self {
136            host_provider: BoxedHostProvider::from_provider(FixedHostProvider::new(hostname)),
137            workload_provider: None,
138            autodiscovery_provider: None,
139            health_registry: health_registry.clone(),
140        })
141    }
142
143    /// Creates a connected `RemoteAgentEnvironmentProvider`, along with the [`Supervisor`] that drives all of the
144    /// provider's background work.
145    ///
146    /// The host, workload, and autodiscovery providers each open their own connection to the Datadog Agent.
147    ///
148    /// # Errors
149    ///
150    /// If any of the underlying providers can't be created, an error is returned.
151    pub async fn connected(
152        settings: &WorkloadSettings, client_config: &RemoteAgentClientConfiguration,
153        component_registry: &ComponentRegistry, health_registry: &HealthRegistry,
154    ) -> Result<(Self, Supervisor), GenericError> {
155        let mut env_supervisor = Supervisor::new("env-provider")?;
156
157        let host_provider = RemoteAgentHostProvider::new(client_config, component_registry).await?;
158
159        let (workload_provider, workload_supervisor) =
160            RemoteAgentWorkloadProvider::new(settings, client_config, component_registry, health_registry).await?;
161        env_supervisor.add_worker(workload_supervisor);
162
163        let (autodiscovery_provider, autodiscovery_supervisor) =
164            RemoteAgentAutodiscoveryProvider::new(client_config).await?;
165        env_supervisor.add_worker(autodiscovery_supervisor);
166
167        let env = Self {
168            host_provider: BoxedHostProvider::from_provider(host_provider),
169            workload_provider: Some(workload_provider),
170            autodiscovery_provider: Some(BoxedAutodiscoveryProvider::from_provider(autodiscovery_provider)),
171            health_registry: health_registry.clone(),
172        };
173
174        Ok((env, env_supervisor))
175    }
176
177    /// Returns a future that resolves once the environment provider's background subsystems are ready.
178    ///
179    /// Specifically, this waits for the workload provider's metadata aggregator and collectors to become ready, which
180    /// ensures that origin detection and entity tagging are operational before the caller begins processing data. In
181    /// standalone mode -- where there is no workload provider -- the returned future resolves immediately.
182    pub fn wait_for_ready(&self) -> impl Future<Output = ()> + Send + 'static {
183        let health_registry = self.health_registry.clone();
184        let has_workload_provider = self.workload_provider.is_some();
185        async move {
186            if has_workload_provider {
187                health_registry.all_ready_under(root_provider_id()).await;
188            }
189        }
190    }
191}

193impl EnvironmentProvider for RemoteAgentEnvironmentProvider {
194    type Host = BoxedHostProvider;
195    type Workload = Option<RemoteAgentWorkloadProvider>;
196    type AutodiscoveryProvider = Option<BoxedAutodiscoveryProvider>;
197
198    fn host(&self) -> &Self::Host {
199        &self.host_provider
200    }
201
202    fn workload(&self) -> &Self::Workload {
203        &self.workload_provider
204    }
205
206    fn autodiscovery(&self) -> &Self::AutodiscoveryProvider {
207        &self.autodiscovery_provider
208    }
209}
